name: popsicle
headline: autonami WordPress marketing automation plugin
short_description: Autonami is a WordPress marketing automation plugin by XLPlugins that enables WooCommerce and WordPress sites to run automated marketing workflows and campaigns.
author: xlplugins

sections.overview:
Autonami Marketing Automations is a WordPress plugin developed by XLPlugins that brings marketing automation capabilities directly to WordPress and WooCommerce-powered websites. The plugin is structured around modular components including automation rules, templates, and compatibilities with other plugins such as WooFunnels. It is designed to help store owners and marketers automate repetitive marketing tasks without leaving their WordPress dashboard. The codebase includes admin, modules, libraries, and public-facing app layers, suggesting support for both backend workflow management and frontend interactions. Teams running WooCommerce stores who need to automate customer engagement and marketing sequences are the primary audience.
Automating follow-up email sequences after WooCommerce purchases
Triggering marketing workflows based on customer behavior on a WordPress site
Managing and deploying reusable automation templates across campaigns
Integrating marketing automation with WooFunnels for funnel-based workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/xlplugins/autonami`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an expert in marketing automation using Autonami. I need a step-by-step guide to set up a [CAMPAIGN_TYPE] campaign for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include specific details about [TARGET_AUDIENCE] and how to use [DATA] to personalize the campaign. Provide best practices for optimizing the campaign's performance.
```
